events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Ramming Speed

options.text: Turn back to save those you can.
Praise the men for a clean hit.
Keep up momentum and search for your next target.

events.text: All is quiet for a moment, before the collision. Then the world erupts with splintering wood and the low groan of metal on timber. The shouts of your men grow into a roar that mixes with the thundering of the waves and the beating of the drums. Once it is over, you leave the ruins of the destroyed ship behind, those fortunate enough to know how to swim clinging onto the debris.
